items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: Bubba, he was a banjo player. We had a banjo in our band. Bubba Bush, he lives out in California now.

ctx.x: Then we all walked that place over there across too. I'll tell you. We went to Mobile once.

I had Clayton, Warren, myself, Bubba, Eddie Thomas, and Sam Williams on Trombone. And we got down on Davis Avenue and everything was the peanut vendor then. And that was our main number. And they said, play the peanut vendor, play the peanut vendor. Excuse me, spread it. Them niggas can't play no peanut vendor. So I said, Jimmy, play Shake It and Break It. Play Shake It and Break It. I said, now I struck the peanut vendor for him. And that was his grip. He really could play it. And Warren could sing it just like…
Oh, I heard him in late years, you know. Oh yeah. I'm talking about in his early years. He's staying up on that trumpet.
